paths.description: Public UK landing page: hero, catalogue rows, pricing entry points, FAQ, footer, consent, responsive and preference conditions.
Subscription plan-selection archetype, representing pricing and commercial commitment disclosure.
MyDisney login-entry form, representing authentication and input assistance.
Invalid route, representing HTTP/navigation failure recovery.

findings.summary: The privacy prompt obscures the primary content on every fresh visit.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show a modal consent wall covering the hero; on 360x800 it occupies nearly the entire viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, content-preserving consent surface with equally prominent accept/reject controls and defer non-essential partner processing until choice.

findings.summary: The consent experience is a custom ARIA dialog rather than the platform dialog primitive.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found two DIV role=dialog aria-modal=true overlays and no dialog element.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native dialog with showModal(), a labelled heading, predictable focus return, and platform dismissal behavior where legally appropriate.

findings.summary: Primary route changes do not expose View Transition styling.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no view-transition rules; homepage-to-login is a full abrupt route change.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive cross-document View Transitions for public marketing-to-login/plan navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: The long marketing page has no scroll-state-aware navigation affordance.
findings.evidence: The page is 5,057px tall at desktop, while CSS inspection found no scroll-state queries or progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a lightweight sticky header state or scroll progress/section cue that responds declaratively to scroll position.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior relies on viewport styling rather than component containment.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout avoids overflow, but CSS inspection found no @container rules despite reusable plan and media-card components.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type and component-scoped container queries for reused cards and plan modules.

findings.summary: Several interactive targets are shorter than recommended touch dimensions.
findings.evidence: The target probe found Learn more links at 14px high and many footer links at 22px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive hit areas to at least 24x24 CSS px, preferably 44px for primary touch controls, without enlarging text unnecessarily.

findings.summary: The public landing page is slow under lab conditions.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 8.4s, LCP 30.8s, TBT 580ms and performance 0.41; the first-party trace still measured LCP 5.18s.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP request chain, prioritize the hero asset, reduce startup JavaScript, and split/defer work not required for first content.

findings.summary: A large JavaScript payload dominates startup.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 1.47MB of script transfer and a 1,009,508-byte _app chunk; Lighthouse estimated 581KiB unused JavaScript and 66KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Split the monolithic app bundle by route, remove unused code, and conditionally load consent, commerce, and catalogue dependencies.

findings.summary: Heading order and accessible-name consistency have defects.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility was 0.99 but failed heading-order and label-content-name-mismatch; the overall heading sequence is not strictly descending.
findings.suggestedFix: Repair heading levels and ensure each control’s accessible name contains its visible label.

findings.summary: The main document lacks baseline defensive headers.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Roll out a nonce/hash-based CSP in report-only then enforced mode; add HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Two first-party cookies are set without Secure.
findings.evidence: Cookie inspection found OptanonConsent and _dd_s without Secure on an HTTPS-only property.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure on every cookie, retain appropriate SameSite, and use HttpOnly for any session-bearing value.

findings.summary: The login entry does not advertise passkey support and omits email autocomplete.
findings.evidence: The login probe found autocomplete="" on the email field and no visible passkey path on the tested entry screen.
findings.suggestedFix: Set autocomplete="username email" and offer a discoverable passkey/WebAuthn route where the MyDisney identity backend supports it.

findings.summary: Many images are oversized or lack intrinsic/responsive metadata.
findings.evidence: The image primitive found 22/43 images missing dimensions, 17 oversized, and 19 without srcset; the logo source was 3837px wide for a 91px display.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve correctly sized AVIF/WebP variants, add width/height, srcset and sizes, and avoid downloading original-resolution logos.

findings.summary: Important rendered semantics are incomplete in raw HTML.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured 52% rendered-word coverage; the raw response lacked the final title and H1, although server HTML was not an empty shell and bot-specific robots rules allow indexing.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the final localized title, H1 and primary link text so non-JS crawlers receive the same semantic entry point.

findings.summary: The initial page has a large memory and DOM footprint.
findings.evidence: The baseline heap summary contained 736,670 nodes and 42.6MB self size; the interaction variant reached 867,880 nodes and 50.3MB, though separate-load variance lowers causal confidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce initial component/data retention, lazy-mount below-fold catalogue sections, and repeat heap comparisons in one persistent target to isolate retained growth.

findings.summary: The page reports browser hygiene problems.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found three BFCache failure reasons and Inspector Issues; best-practices scored 0.77.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove avoidable BFCache blockers and resolve the concrete DevTools Issues entries, then verify back/forward restoration.

findings.summary: The unauthenticated landing page has a broad partner and third-party surface.
findings.evidence: The consent copy states 77 partners; HAR recorded 91 cross-origin requests and 2.62MB cross-origin transfer, including consent and logging services, though the tracker matcher found no known tracker domains.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit every partner against necessity, load optional vendors only after consent, and minimize/batch telemetry.
